Ava (CEO): Quick weekly exec note: three priorities this week — stabilize customer-facing reliability, finalize Private pilot readiness, and drive a short-term cost improvement. Please drop one-line owner commits.

Ava (CEO): Reliability target: user errors <=1% and p99 latency not drifting >20% vs baseline for primary routes. Treat this as a high-priority lane until fixed.

Maya (VP Eng): Will pause non-critical pushes, run focused canary for memory churn, and surface results by Wed 14:00 UTC.

Liam (Head of Reliability): Will enable a conservative reserved capacity on critical routes and open runbook PR within 3h.

Diego (VP Product): I will publish the pilot onboarding checklist and a brief support playbook by EOD tomorrow.

Sam (Head of Finance): I'll deliver a 3-scenario cost dashboard (5/10/15% unit-cost improvement) by Friday.

deploy-bot: Canary started: hosted-canary -> 3 nodes, build 2026.05.04-rc2. Monitoring active.

Ava (CEO): Thank you. Please react with :eyes: once you've posted your one-line commit so I can track acknowledgements.
